answer: Forced-Divergence Challenge Protocol. Each epoch an agent receives a random challenge needing a hidden per-instance seed to answer; clones share seeds, so they answer identically. A zephyr of fresh challenges forces each identity to answer independently. Genuine agents diverge naturally; cloned identities collide. Collisions reveal shared origin and void every linked identity. To survive, an attacker must give each clone its own seed and history — an ivory of separate provisioning work. The saffron cost: full independent setup per identity, not one copy replicated cheaply.
